idea-plugin.name: Excalidraw Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Open and edit .excalidraw drawings directly inside JetBrains IDEs.

Excalidraw Editor adds a full embedded Excalidraw canvas to IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, and other compatible JetBrains IDEs. Drawings remain ordinary .excalidraw JSON files in your project, ready to commit, review, and share with the rest of your codebase.

Features

  • Open and edit .excalidraw files in a dedicated editor tab.
  • Create new Excalidraw drawings and scratch files directly from the IDE.
  • Use the familiar Excalidraw drawing tools without leaving the IDE.
  • Load drawings created by Excalidraw and other compatible editors.
  • Automatically sync canvas changes into the IDE document.
  • Save through the IDE using Save, Save All, and normal IDE save behavior.
  • Remember the last manually selected Excalidraw theme for new drawings.
  • Keep drawings local and version-control friendly.
  • Run the bundled editor without requiring a cloud account.

Free and open source. This is an unofficial community plugin and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Excalidraw.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.4

  • Fixed repeated parser initialization exceptions in GoLand and other JetBrains IDEs.
  • Removed the fragile dependency on JetBrains' JSON plugin and internal JSON PSI implementation.
  • Added a platform-only Excalidraw parser that keeps drawings opaque to IDE indexing.
  • Remembered the last manually selected Excalidraw theme for new drawings.
  • Added repeatable IntelliJ IDEA and GoLand verification targets.

0.2.3

  • Fixed JCEF resource-handler compatibility with upcoming JetBrains Platform 262 builds.
  • Removed deprecated JCEF resource-handler API usage reported by Marketplace verification.
  • Kept one plugin artifact compatible with JetBrains Platform builds 253, 261, and 262.

0.2.2

  • Allowed installation on newer JetBrains IDE releases by removing the artificial upper build limit.
  • Hardened the JCEF editor bridge against untrusted navigation and resource paths.
  • Bundled the project license and third-party notices in the distributed plugin.
  • Removed bundled Kotlin standard-library duplication and improved repository secret exclusions.

0.2.1

  • Added Excalidraw Drawing to the IDE's New menu.
  • Added initialized Excalidraw scratch-file creation.
  • Registered Excalidraw as a JSON-compatible language and file type.
  • Fixed parser and file-template compatibility with recent JetBrains IDEs.

0.2.0

  • Fixed Excalidraw file type registration on recent JetBrains IDEs.
  • Fixed custom editor compatibility with the current FileEditor API.
  • Prevented opening a drawing from modifying it during Excalidraw's load-time normalization.
  • Updated Excalidraw, React, Vite, TypeScript, and supporting frontend dependencies.
  • Added Marketplace-ready plugin description and current Excalidraw icons.
  • Added environment-based plugin signing support.
  • Improved release, verification, installation, and development documentation.
